description: This file defines the GuzzleHandler class responsible for sending PSR-7 compliant HTTP requests using Guzzle 5. It acts as an adapter between PSR-7 requests/responses and Guzzle 5's request execution, handling options, request creation, and response adaptation.

classes.name: GuzzleHandler
classes.description: A request handler that sends PSR-7-compatible requests with Guzzle 5, acting as an adapter for the Guzzle HTTP client to work with PSR-7 request and response objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an optional Guzzle ClientInterface.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles sending a PSR-7 request asynchronously, returns a promise resolving to a PSR-7 response.

methods.name: createGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Creates a Guzzle 5 request object from a PSR-7 request and options.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle 5 response into a PSR-7 response.

methods.name: prepareErrorData
methods.description: Prepares an error array from an exception, adding details if it's a connection or request error.
